name: init_system
purpose: resets callbacks, starts GPU, GTE, memory card and pads, sets both draw buffers, loads the rock file tables and creates the first task.

name: set_resolution
purpose: switches screen resolution.

name: create_task
purpose: opens the thread of task slot arg0 with entry arg1 and marks it running.

name: task_yield
purpose: sets the current task's wait count to arg0 and switches back to the main thread.

name: end_task_slot
purpose: closes the thread of task slot arg0 and clears its state.

name: load_player_files
purpose: player file selection on loading screen.

name: init_loading_screen
purpose: loading screen per-call step.

name: load_rock_dat_file_table
purpose: reads the ROCK_X6.DAT file table (0xF3 entries) into rock_dat_file_table, plus 4 files.

name: load_vab_record
purpose: CD record handler D_80010038[2] (cmd>>16==2): SsVabOpenHeadSticky on the record head, body to SPU.

name: wait_for_file_load
purpose: yields each frame until the file load finishes, showing the loading screen and re-seeking or resetting the CD on errors.

name: pump_file_loads
purpose: steps the queued DAT file reads and re-issues a read on CD error status.

name: read_dat_file
purpose: reads a DAT file by index.

name: load_rock_bin_file_table
purpose: reads the ROCK_X6.BIN file table (0x3B entries) into rock_bin_file_table.

name: read_rock_bin_member
purpose: reads ROCK_X6.BIN member arg0 into buffer arg1 from rock_bin_file_table[arg0] (lba, size).

name: play_sound
purpose: VAB play #1.

name: key_on_sfx_voices
purpose: keys on the SPU voices of a sound entry with per-voice priority and pan from the source object's screen x.

name: play_sfx_sequence
purpose: stops a lower-priority sequence on the entry's channel, plays the SEQ or SEP and records the channel priority.

name: load_player_sound_seqs
purpose: closes open SEP handles, reads the controlled player's sound data file and opens its two SEP sets at full volume.

name: silence_sound
purpose: zeroes the volume of and keys off a range of sound voices (all 24 for 0xFF).

name: set_animation
purpose: animation trigger; table at +0x30.

name: set_animation_frame
purpose: points an object's animation cursor at entry arg1 of its table plus arg2.

name: play_bgm_xa_track
purpose: plays BGM.XA track arg0 (dat slot 0xF5) via func_80016548; arg0 indexes the 16-byte track table D_8006E58C.

name: play_demo_xa_track
purpose: plays DEMO.XA track arg0 (dat slot 0xF6) via func_80016548; arg0 indexes a track table.

name: play_stage_bgm
purpose: plays the XA music track for the current stage, substage and player.

name: stop_cd_audio
purpose: pauses CD audio playback and turns off the serial audio input.

name: play_str_movie
purpose: plays movie str_movie_table[arg0] (stride 12, word 0 = dat slot) via func_8001B6D0 + VSync/PutDispEnv loop.

name: memcard_read_save_file
purpose: reads the 0x2000-byte save file from the memory card in slot arg1.

name: memcard_list_files
purpose: lists the card's files whose name matches, and sums their sizes.

name: memcard_format
purpose: formats the memory card in the given slot.

name: init_title_screen
purpose: title screen voice.

name: tick_title_demo_timer
purpose: title screen demo timer.

name: init_new_game
purpose: new game status init.

name: exit_stage_by_clear
purpose: scene triggers after stage clear.

name: run_text_box
purpose: per-frame text box step: updates the active text box, else opens the pending text id.

name: open_text_box
purpose: text box first page.

name: load_speaker_palette
purpose: loads the palette of the speaker of text arg0 into CLUT slot 0x16, or 0x5F in wide mode.

name: get_player_mugshot
purpose: player mugshot selection.

name: set_boss_level
purpose: sets current boss level from rank.

name: func_80029478
purpose: sets the vertical shake fields and flag 1 of background object 0 (mmx4 start_screen_shake_y shape).

name: init_checkpoint_positions
purpose: places the player and the background layers at the current checkpoint.

name: init_options_menu
purpose: options list display and toggles.

name: load_palette
purpose: on-the-fly palette load.

name: reset_level
purpose: generic reset at level start.

name: enemy_slot_alloc
purpose: first free 0x9C slot of the enemy object array g_enemies[48], cleared; returns it or 0.

name: alloc_class3_slot
purpose: returns a cleared free slot of the class 3 pool g_class3_slots.

name: alloc_class4_slot
purpose: returns a cleared free slot of the class 4 pool g_class4_slots.

name: alloc_sprite_slot
purpose: free slot in displayed sprites table.

name: alloc_class6_slot
purpose: returns a cleared free slot of the class 6 pool g_class6_slots.

name: alloc_class7_slot
purpose: returns a cleared free slot of the class 7 pool g_class7_slots.

name: clear_object_slot
purpose: zeroes the first eight bytes of an object slot.

name: move_object
purpose: adds x_vel to x_pos and subtracts y_vel from y_pos.

name: random_byte
purpose: steps the random seed and returns its low byte.

name: set_velocity_from_angle
purpose: sets x_vel and y_vel from the speed tables for a 32-step angle.

name: check_attack_hit
purpose: player attack hit detection.

name: check_box_collision
purpose: checks a general box collision.

name: scale_damage
purpose: damage taken scaled by armor and difficulty.

name: check_enemy_hits
purpose: attack slots tested against enemies.

name: collide_solid_object
purpose: box-collides the player (mode 0) and the ride armor (mode 1) with the object's terrain box, restoring the old position on blocked moves.

name: setup_pause_menu
purpose: pause menu display.

name: exit_stage_from_menu
purpose: scene triggers on exit stage.

name: update_player
purpose: per-frame player step: timers, weapon switch, the player state handler table, charge and shot, flash.

name: update_stage_entry
purpose: stage-start drop-in: phase 0 falls until the floor flag (latched & 8), phase 1 runs player init on the animation event and hands off at the animation end.

name: update_stand
purpose: standing: runs the move checks in order (ladder, attack, ceiling jump, walk, dash); with none taken, plays the idle animation.

name: update_walk_start
purpose: walk start: the move checks, then moves while the start animation runs and goes on to walking at its end; stands when check_walk_start_input drops.

name: func_800354E8
purpose: walking: the move checks, then moves and animates while check_walk_input holds, else stands (func_8003ADB4).

name: handle_jump_rise
purpose: jump rising state.

name: func_80035D38
purpose: action 26 routine: facing from pressed input, attack checks, three animation phases, then standing.

name: func_8003605C
purpose: action 27 routine: vertical step helpers, a sound every 21 frames while y moves.

name: func_800361D4
purpose: action 28 routine: horizontal step helpers, a sound every 21 frames while x moves.

name: func_80036364
purpose: action 30 routine: airborne phase, a decelerating ground slide after touchdown, then an override check.

name: perform_ceiling_jump
purpose: ceiling jump execution; duration per character.

name: func_800365D4
purpose: action 31 phase 3, after perform_ceiling_jump meets a ceiling: dash input goes to phase 4; holds while the ceiling flag stays and DOWN/CROSS are not pressed, counting action_timer down; ends through end_dash.

name: update_move_off_screen
purpose: phase 0 waits for the animation end and sets animation 4; phase 1 moves until is_off_screen reports the object out of view, then turns it off (state 3).

name: func_80036800
purpose: the move checks without the attack and ceiling-jump tests; start_walk when check_walk_start_input holds, else ends at the animation end (func_8003AD18).

name: update_fall
purpose: falling: lands on the floor flag (or ceiling jump), else the air checks (wall cling, air dash) then gravity and motion.

name: update_landing
purpose: landing: the move checks, then the landing animation; stands (func_8003ADB4) at its end.

name: update_wall_cling
purpose: wall cling: lands on the floor flag; while touching a wall faces away from it and counts unk8A down, then start_slide_down (slide); else func_8003AFF4.

name: update_wall_jump
purpose: jump from a wall: phase 0 runs update_wall_jump_push (push off), later phases update_wall_jump_rise (rise).

name: update_wall_jump_push
purpose: wall jump phase 0: moves away from the wall for unk8A frames, then zeroes x_vel and goes to phase 1; func_8003AFF4 on lock, ceiling or a wall ahead.

name: update_wall_jump_rise
purpose: wall jump phase 1: rises; y_vel cut on lock, ceiling or CROSS release; air checks; falls (action 7) once y_vel <= 0.

name: update_slide_down
purpose: wall slide: phase 0 runs handle_slide_down, later phases update_slide_down_let_go.

name: handle_slide_down
purpose: sliding-down state routine.

name: update_slide_down_let_go
purpose: action 11 phase 1+: lands on the floor flag, func_8003AFF4 on lock; else moves for unk8A frames, then falls (action 7) with x_vel 0.

name: update_dash
purpose: ground dash: unless func_8003A628, animates and runs dash_phase_table[action_phase]; set_pose_size when the action changed and a terrain box is set.

name: func_80037130
purpose: lands on the floor flag, func_8003AFF4 on lock; tries func_80039984 and the ladder; X attacking goes to func_8003B360; else animates and runs D_80073C10[action_phase].

name: func_80037220
purpose: action 13 phase 0: stops all motion when func_801EC028 holds (not X); animation event 0x40 runs func_8003D26C, event 0x80 plays sound 1/5, sets afterimage and goes to phase 1.

name: func_800372DC
purpose: action 13 phase 1: stops all motion when func_801EC028 holds (not X); check_dash_end leads to func_8003B30C; animation event 0x40 runs func_8003D26C.

name: func_8003744C
purpose: calls the phase routine D_80073C1C[obj[6]] with the object.

name: player_ladder_climb_on_top
purpose: action 14 phase 2: animates the move between ladder top and tile; at its end shifts y 16 px and enters the climb-down state (player_enter_ladder_climb_down).

name: player_ladder_step_off_bottom
purpose: action 14 phase 3: animates, then stands (func_8003ADB4) on the ground at the animation end.

name: update_ladder_climb_up
purpose: ladder climb up: try_leave_ladder first; turns with LEFT/RIGHT presses; UP held moves and animates; DOWN switches to the climb-down state (player_enter_ladder_climb_down).

name: update_ladder_climb_down
purpose: ladder climb down: try_leave_ladder first; turns with LEFT/RIGHT presses; DOWN held moves and animates; UP switches to the climb-up state (player_enter_ladder_climb_up).

name: player_ladder_let_go
purpose: action 14 phase 4: animates, then func_8003AFF4 at the animation end.

name: player_hurt
purpose: runs the hurt handler that the player's hurt type selects.

name: update_hurt_knockback
purpose: hurt handler for hurt types 0, 1 and 4: x motion through move_x_backward; when invincibility_timer reaches 0x3C runs end_dash, then check_low_health unless locked.

name: func_80037920
purpose: hurt handler for hurt type 5: x motion through func_80037B10; when invincibility_timer reaches 0x3C runs func_8003AFF4, then check_low_health unless locked.

name: func_800379AC
purpose: hurt handler for hurt type 3: faces the held direction; steps unkCA through animations 0x25 and 0x24, and runs end_dash when it reaches 0.

name: move_x_backward
purpose: x motion that only goes backward: stops x at a wall ahead in the motion, moves, then drops an x_vel that points the way the player faces.

name: func_80037B10
purpose: as move_x_backward, and also zeroes y_vel when the motion meets a wall.

name: func_80037BC4
purpose: g_playthrough_state.unkF set leads to func_8003B870; hover_timer 0 ends the state (air_action 1, gameplay unlocked); phase 0 sets animation unkD8.

name: func_80037C74
purpose: phase 0 runs func_80037CB4, later phases func_80037D68.

name: func_80037CB4
purpose: action 19 phase 0: not riding: stands on the floor flag, else zeroes motion with base gravity and goes to phase 1; riding: animates on the ground.

name: func_80037D68
purpose: action 19 phase 1+: lands on the floor flag, else animates and moves.

name: update_control_lock
purpose: control lock: waits and animates while unkD0 is set, then stands (action 2); seen during the opening dialog.

name: func_80037E1C
purpose: phase 0 animates until D_800CCEDF is set; phase 1 turns the object off (state 3).

name: func_80037E88
purpose: D_800CCEDF set leads to func_8003B870; else x_vel from walk_start_speed/walk_speed by the animation event, signed by facing; moves, animates, func_8003A678 when unkD2 is 0.

name: func_80037F34
purpose: unless func_8003A628 takes over, moves and animates.

name: player_script_vanish
purpose: animates the player, then hides it at the last step.

name: func_80037FD4
purpose: action 23 handler: moves until y_vel ends, then on landing sets action 20.

name: func_8003809C
purpose: action 24 handler: waits for item_step 4, plays animation 0x27 with sound 0x21, then func_8003D330 and func_8003AD18.

name: func_80038144
purpose: action 25 handler: waits for D_800CD40C to clear, plays animation 0x27 with sound 0x21, then animation 0x28 and func_8003B954.

name: update_ceiling_jump
purpose: action 31 handler, the ceiling jump: falls through func_8003AFF4 under move_lock, else runs ceiling_jump_phase_table[action_phase].

name: end_ceiling_jump
purpose: ceiling_jump_phase_table[1] (action 31 phase 1): animates every other frame, counts action_timer down, then zeroes speed and falls (action 7).

name: func_800382C8
purpose: ceiling_jump_phase_table[2] (action 31 phase 2): animates; at the animation end advances the phase and sets animation 0x54.

name: func_80038310
purpose: ceiling_jump_phase_table[4] (action 31 phase 4): animation event 0x40 calls func_8003D26C; event 0x80 plays sound 1/5, sets afterimage, advances the phase.

name: func_80038390
purpose: ceiling_jump_phase_table[5] (action 31 phase 5): when check_dash_end ends the dash, func_8003B30C and action 13; event 0x40 calls func_8003D26C.

name: func_800383F8
purpose: spawns a visual object (find_free_visual_obj) at the caller, mirrored, with g_visual_animation_tables animations; the sound and variant follow the caller id.

name: func_80038594
purpose: horizontal step under overhead tiles 0x25-0x2F, at unk12C while dash_timer runs and the facing side is held, else by L/R at unk124; returns 0, 1 left, 2 right.

name: func_80038788
purpose: vertical step under overhead tile 0x2E, at y_vel while dash_timer runs and its side is held, else by UP/DOWN at unk128; returns 0, 1 up, 2 down.

name: func_800389B4
purpose: action 27 move step (from func_8003605C): UP/DOWN under tile 0x2E (func_80038788 while dashing), then animation by direction, shot and attack.

name: func_80038BA8
purpose: on dash press or double tap, starts a vertical dash under tile 0x2E: dash_momentum, air_action 1, dash_timer 30 (15 with part 0x10), sound; returns 1.

name: func_80038CD0
purpose: action 28 move step (from func_800361D4): L/R under tiles 0x25-0x2F (func_80038594 while dashing), y snap by snap_to_tile_slope, animation by tile.

name: func_80038F64
purpose: on dash press or double tap, starts a horizontal dash under tiles 0x25-0x2F, set up as in func_80038BA8; returns 1 when started.

name: select_air_dash
purpose: air dash picked by armor.

name: update_player_damage
purpose: damage pass each frame: crush and spike deaths, hit damage, invincibility countdown; a pending hurt (hp bit 7) runs start_hurt and refills energy.

name: start_hurt
purpose: starts the hurt: vibration, hurt sounds, then unless in action 17, animation, speeds and invincibility from the hurt-type tables and action 17.

name: snap_to_tile_slope
purpose: sets y from the slope profile of overhead tile 0x25-0x2D at x (0x2F probes 16 px up, then down); returns the tile.

name: func_80039984
purpose: UP held over overhead tile 0x2E sets action 27 centred on it; over tiles 0x25-0x2D while not rising, action 28 with the y snap; returns 1 when taken.

name: player_check_dash_jump_walk
purpose: starts a dash, jump or walk from the input.

name: func_80039C40
purpose: dash or jump check: a dash input starts a dash, else a JUMP press starts a jump; returns 1 when taken.

name: check_crouch_input
purpose: with D_800CCF99 bit 0x08 set and DOWN held, calls func_8003B9AC; returns 1 when taken.

name: check_walk_start_input
purpose: walk-start input: L or R held sets facing and x_vel to +-walk_start_speed unless a wall blocks that side; returns 1 when set.

name: check_walk_input
purpose: walk input: L or R held sets facing and x_vel to +-walk_speed unless a wall blocks that side; returns 1 when set.

name: check_floor_lost
purpose: grounded (air_state 0) with no floor contact, not hurt, hovering or riding: falls through func_8003AFF4.

name: check_dash_input
purpose: dash input incl. double tap.

name: update_double_tap_dash
purpose: double-tap detection: an L/R press opens a 12-frame window; the same side again sets double_tap_dash.

name: check_dash_end
purpose: dash step: moves, keeps x_vel at least dash_base_speed; returns 1 when the dash ends (wall ahead, dash_timer out, nothing held, other side held).

name: check_dash_end_no_release
purpose: dash step as check_dash_end without the nothing-held end; returns 1 when the dash ends.

name: func_8003A1C8
purpose: with ride_animation set and not hurt: animation 0x26 from a standing pose, facing right, action 19.

name: func_8003A268
purpose: with hover_timer above 0: clears terrain_box, airborne, action 18 phase 1, negates hover_timer.

name: try_enter_wall_cling
purpose: enters wall cling when not locked and touching a wall; returns 1 when taken.

name: try_wall_jump
purpose: on a climbable wall with CROSS pressed, calls start_wall_jump (the wall jump); returns 1 when taken.

name: is_pressing_into_wall
purpose: returns 1 when L/R is held into a touching climbable wall.

name: try_enter_ladder
purpose: grabs a ladder (input bit 4 over tile 0x20) or climbs on top (bit 8 over tile 0x21); returns 1 when taken.

name: try_grab_ladder_from_air
purpose: UP held over tile 0x20 at the origin grabs the ladder (animation 0x1F and player_enter_ladder_climb_up, or func_801EB6E8 when attacking); returns 1.

name: try_leave_ladder
purpose: while climbing: steps off at the floor, tops out on tile 0x21, or falls when off the ladder tiles or on a button.

name: func_8003A764
purpose: exit test of actions 27 and 28: leaves by tile attribute, timer +0xD0 or jump press; returns 1 when it leaves.

name: func_8003A814
purpose: maps a tile attribute and the facing to an animation offset 0, 1 or 2.

name: check_ceiling_jump
purpose: ceiling jump input (Shadow legs, Zero Hyoroga).

name: cancel_player_attack
purpose: sets byte +0xCF, clears dash_momentum and afterimage, then calls two helpers.

name: start_dash
purpose: enters the ground dash (action 12, dash_timer 30 or 15), or a dash jump (action 6) on a jump press.

name: start_walk
purpose: enters walk start (action 3) with y speed, x acceleration and gravity cleared.

name: func_8003AED4
purpose: enters walking (action 4) with y speed, x acceleration and gravity cleared.

name: player_land
purpose: touchdown: plays a sound, tries dash, jump or walk, else enters landing (action 8).

name: end_dash
purpose: Mach Dash end.

name: func_8003B360
purpose: enters action 7 with velocities cleared, gravity from +0x100 and animation 0x84.

name: player_enter_wall_cling
purpose: enters the wall cling: animation 0xD, sound 1/4, motion and gravity zeroed, unk8A 8, faces away from the wall, action 9.

name: start_wall_jump
purpose: starts action 10: faces and pushes x away from the wall, dash speed if CIRCLE held, sets the rise speed.

name: start_slide_down
purpose: starts action 11: dust unless armor 2, x speed 0, y speed from slide_down_speed (the slide speed).

name: func_8003B5B8
purpose: enters action 11 phase 1: x speed away from the wall, base gravity back on.

name: grab_ladder
purpose: enters action 14: centres x on the tile, zeroes speeds, climb speed from unk118.

name: reach_ladder_top
purpose: enters action 14 phase 1: snaps y to the tile and clears the attack.

name: player_enter_ladder_climb_on_top
purpose: starts climbing down onto a ladder from its top: animation 0x1D, x snapped to the tile centre, action 14 phase 2.

name: player_enter_ladder_step_off_bottom
purpose: starts stepping off the ladder bottom: animation 0x1E, action 14 phase 3.

name: player_enter_ladder_climb_down
purpose: enters action 16: x snapped to the tile column centre, y speed minus +0x11C.

name: func_8003B9AC
purpose: enters action 26 unless the override check func_8003A628 takes over.

name: func_8003C3C8
purpose: sets the per-frame box pointer +0x54 from tables indexed by animation and frame.

name: player_spawn_dash_spark
purpose: spawns the spark visual offset from dash_spark_offsets by variant, or calls spawn_dash_tile24_visual when the tile below is 0x24.

name: spawn_wall_jump_visual
purpose: spawns visual object 3/1 at a per-character offset from the object.

name: read_player_input
purpose: in-game input reading.

name: player_update_flash
purpose: steps the shot and hurt palette flashes.

name: check_low_health
purpose: low health voice site.

name: spawn_dust
purpose: dust animation start.

name: set_base_move_stats
purpose: writes the base movement speeds and gravity into the player.

name: init_move_stats
purpose: base movement stats, then the deltas of equipped parts and armor 2.

name: load_armor_and_parts
purpose: player init: copies armor, parts and beaten stages from the playthrough state.

name: map_buttons
purpose: read input subroutine.

name: switch_weapon
purpose: weapon menu-select input.

name: func_8003DD6C
purpose: character 0 weapon switch: both shoulder buttons clear it, one steps the nine slots.

name: set_shot_types
purpose: sets the two shot types from armor, weapon, charge and parts.

name: func_8003E06C
purpose: fires a shot and starts the attack pose, for two unnamed ground states.

name: try_shoot_in_air
purpose: fires a shot and starts the attack pose in the air states.

name: try_shoot_on_ladder
purpose: fires a shot from the ladder, or enters the ladder shot state.

name: check_giga_attack
purpose: giga attack input, armor checks, execution.

name: get_weapon_energy_cost
purpose: energy cost by armor and parts.

name: update_player_charge
purpose: per-frame charge step: on fire input resets the charge, else charges.

name: func_8003ED98
purpose: tests the fire input bits 0x10/0x20 and their press history.

name: charge_special_weapon
purpose: charging special weapons by armor.

name: update_weapon_switch
purpose: runs switch_weapon when requested, else steps the weapon selection and reacts when the weapon byte 0x93 changed.

name: start_hover
purpose: Blade hover boots execution.

name: try_start_air_dash
purpose: on dash input sets animation 0xBD and state 0x4A, zeroes speeds and spawns the dash effect; returns 1 when taken.

name: try_start_shot_attack
purpose: X only: tries a giga attack, else starts the attack of a fired shot type; returns 1 when one starts.

name: use_weapon_energy
purpose: energy deduction on shot.

name: start_player_attack
purpose: jump table on the attack id (byte 0x96) to start_saber and nine other attack starters.

name: player_fire_weapon
purpose: spawns the player's current shot type as a weapon object.

name: fire_charged_shot
purpose: X charged shot sound.

name: start_saber
purpose: X saber start.

name: player_set_charge_flash
purpose: sets flash_palette from charge slot arg1 level; returns 1 when that slot is charging.

name: update_special_charge
purpose: charge-path step of update_player_charge, asm body not yet read.

name: init_orb
purpose: enemy orb drop and value.

name: register_orb
purpose: orb registered until Nightmare reset.

name: init_yammar_option
purpose: Yammar Option fireflies; ammo.

name: update_guard_shell
purpose: Guard Shell activation and ammo use.

name: clamp_player_to_ceiling
purpose: player/ceiling position compare.

name: func_800472D0
purpose: object init: speed and timer by stage, difficulty and checkpoint.

name: func_80047394
purpose: object step: runs the D_800762C8 action handler unless 0x80097180 is 2.

name: func_800473EC
purpose: object action: adds speed while the player acts, resets by difficulty.

name: move_ceiling
purpose: ceiling movement step.

name: func_8004755C
purpose: state 2 of the D_800762C8 object: moves until a countdown or flag, then shakes the screen and changes state.

name: func_80047674
purpose: state 3 of the D_800762C8 object: moves for a countdown, then sets speed and state 1.

name: func_800476E0
purpose: state 4 of the D_800762C8 object: waits a countdown, then resets position and sets state 1.

name: func_80047760
purpose: state 5 of the D_800762C8 object: waits a countdown, plays a sound, then sets state 3.

name: init_buster_shot_visual
purpose: buster shot sfx by shot type.

name: update_buster_shot_visual
purpose: buster shot visual object update: freed on the stage-exit mode, init on state 0, else its step.

name: update_dust
purpose: dust animation control; stops on wall let-go/kick.

name: drop_item
purpose: item drop; off on Xtreme.

name: rescue_reploid
purpose: rescued reploid reward.

name: set_reploid_status
purpose: writes 4-bit status arg1 of rescue reploid arg0.

name: get_reploid_status
purpose: returns the 4-bit status of rescue reploid arg0.

name: init_capsule
purpose: capsule appearance checks parts.

name: update_capsule
purpose: capsule object update: init on state 0, else its step; part 0x10 follows its link as a solid box.

name: apply_capsule_part
purpose: capsule applies part, mugshot, saber palette.

name: is_text_box_seen
purpose: tests the seen bit of text box arg0 for the current stage.

name: set_text_box_seen
purpose: sets the seen bit of text box arg0 for the current stage.

name: init_shuriken_buster
purpose: Shadow armor shuriken buster.

name: update_shadow_armor_attack
purpose: Shadow armor attack execution; sfx ids.

name: start_rekkoha
purpose: Rekkoha input (Zero).

name: update_rekkoha
purpose: Rekkoha state handler: animates, plays its sound on flag 0x45 and runs the substate table.

name: try_hyoroga_from_ceiling
purpose: starts the Hyoroga from the ceiling when weapon energy allows: animation, sound, energy use, state 0x3F.

name: update_d1000
